room.prompt: A probe station seen from just above a wafer: a grid of dies across the front, a card of fine probe needles hanging just above, soft green test light.

stage.where: on one die in the front middle
stage.near: the neighbouring dies are its own size, the needles hair-thin beside it

touch.prompt: the fine probe needles have come down and touch only the small pads around the edges of the front die

map.prompt: A test map for an animated film: a round wafer drawn as a grid of small squares, most of them green, a few red, one square in the middle outlined brightly, no labels

d_up.pose: looking up at something coming down from above, drawing in a breath

d_hold.pose: holding very still, cheeks puffed, holding its breath, eyes squeezed

d_ask.pose: looking off to the right, hopeful and nervous, asking

d_relief.pose: shoulders dropping in relief, a big relieved smile, a small green glow
